note: The two factors of the weight-ratio bound are proved separately for a general pseudometric Cost: the exponential factor in Cost.weight_triangle and the polynomial factor in Mark.radial_move (Polar.lean), which goes on to absorb (1+d)^P into polynomial(delta,P)*e^{delta d}. Their product is the record's inequality. Lean states it for the FreeResolvent weights, which carry growing inputs, not specifically for the W_0 coarse displacement.

snippet.text:
lemma weight_triangle {σ : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ σ) (x y z : X) :
    D.weight σ x z ≤ D.weight σ x y * D.weight σ y z := by
  simp only [weight, ← Real.exp_add, Real.exp_le_exp, ← mul_add]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (D.triangle ..) h

proof_context.conclusion: For sigma >= 0, weight sigma x z <= weight sigma x y * weight sigma y z: the exponential factor e^{a|y-y'|} of the ratio bound, from the triangle inequality.

lemma radial_move (τ : Type*) (o : X) (P : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : Move (radial τ D o P) D δ (polynomial δ P) := by
  constructor; intro t x y
  let A := 1+D.d x o
  let B := 1+D.d y o
  have ha : 0 < A := by unfold A; have := D.nonneg x o; linarith
  have hb : 0 < B := by unfold B; have := D.nonneg y o; linarith
  have hh : B^P ≤ (polynomial δ P*D.weight δ x y)*A^P := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ((1+D.d x y)*A)^P := pow_le_pow_left₀ hb.le (by unfold B A; nlinarith only [D.triangle y x o,D.comm y x, mul_nonneg (D.nonneg x y) (D.nonneg x o)]) P
      _ = (1+D.d x y)^P*A^P := mul_pow ..
      _ ≤ (polynomial δ P*D.weight δ x y)*A^P := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (poly_weight P hδ (D.nonneg ..)) (by positivity)
  change (A^P)⁻¹ ≤ _ * (B^P)⁻¹
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hb _), inv_mul_eq_div, div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos ha _)]; exact hh

proof_context.conclusion: From (1+d(y,o)) <= (1+d(x,y))(1+d(x,o)) (line 260, the triangle inequality), the polynomial weight ratio satisfies (1+d(y,o))^P/(1+d(x,o))^P <= (1+d(x,y))^P <= polynomial delta P * e^{delta d(x,y)}.
